### @ArrayUnique(identifierOrOptions?, validationOptions?)

Source: https://github.com/typestack/class-validator/blob/develop/_autodocs/api-reference/decorators-array-object.md

Checks that all array values are unique. Comparison is reference-based for objects unless an identifier function is supplied.

```APIDOC
## @ArrayUnique(identifierOrOptions?, validationOptions?)

### Description
Checks all array values are unique. Comparison is reference-based for objects, unless an identifier function is supplied.

### Signature
```ts
export const ARRAY_UNIQUE = 'arrayUnique';
export type ArrayUniqueIdentifier<T = any> = (o: T) => any;
export function arrayUnique(array: unknown[], identifier?: ArrayUniqueIdentifier): boolean;
export function ArrayUnique<T = any>(
  identifierOrOptions?: ArrayUniqueIdentifier<T> | ValidationOptions,
  validationOptions?: ValidationOptions
): PropertyDecorator;
```

### Parameters
- `identifierOrOptions` (ArrayUniqueIdentifier<T> | ValidationOptions) - Optional - Either an identifier function mapping items to comparable values, or `ValidationOptions`.
- `validationOptions` (ValidationOptions) - Optional - Used when the first argument is an identifier function.

### Returns
`PropertyDecorator`
```

--------------------------------

### @IsArray(validationOptions?)

Source: https://github.com/typestack/class-validator/blob/develop/_autodocs/api-reference/decorators-typechecker.md

Checks that the value is an array. Returns a PropertyDecorator.

```APIDOC
## @IsArray(validationOptions?)

### Description
Checks that the value is an array.

### Signature
```ts
export const IS_ARRAY = 'isArray';
export function isArray<T = any>(value: unknown): value is Array<T>;
export function IsArray(validationOptions?: ValidationOptions): PropertyDecorator;
```

### Parameters
- **validationOptions** (`ValidationOptions`) - Optional - Validation options.

### Returns
- `PropertyDecorator`
```

--------------------------------

### @ArrayMaxSize(max, validationOptions?)

Source: https://github.com/typestack/class-validator/blob/develop/_autodocs/api-reference/decorators-array-object.md

Checks that the array length is less than or equal to the maximum.

```APIDOC
## @ArrayMaxSize(max, validationOptions?)

### Description
Checks the array length is `<= max`.

### Signature
```ts
export const ARRAY_MAX_SIZE = 'arrayMaxSize';
export function arrayMaxSize(array: unknown, max: number): boolean;
export function ArrayMaxSize(max: number, validationOptions?: ValidationOptions): PropertyDecorator;
```

### Parameters
- `max` (number) - Required - The maximum array length.
- `validationOptions` (ValidationOptions) - Optional - Validation options.

### Returns
`PropertyDecorator`
```

--------------------------------

### @IsInt(validationOptions?)

Source: https://github.com/typestack/class-validator/blob/develop/_autodocs/api-reference/decorators-typechecker.md

Checks that the value is an integer (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value)). Returns a PropertyDecorator.

```APIDOC
## @IsInt(validationOptions?)

### Description
Checks that the value is an integer (`typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value)`).

### Signature
```ts

export function isInt(val: unknown): val is Number;
export function IsInt(validationOptions?: ValidationOptions): PropertyDecorator;
```

### Parameters
- **validationOptions** (`ValidationOptions`) - Optional - Validation options.

### Returns
- `PropertyDecorator`
```

--------------------------------

### @ArrayMinSize(min, validationOptions?)

Source: https://github.com/typestack/class-validator/blob/develop/_autodocs/api-reference/decorators-array-object.md

Checks that the array length is greater than or equal to the minimum.

```APIDOC
## @ArrayMinSize(min, validationOptions?)

### Description
Checks the array length is `>= min`.

### Signature
```ts
export const ARRAY_MIN_SIZE = 'arrayMinSize';
export function arrayMinSize(array: unknown, min: number): boolean;
export function ArrayMinSize(min: number, validationOptions?: ValidationOptions): PropertyDecorator;
```

### Parameters
- `min` (number) - Required - The minimum array length.
- `validationOptions` (ValidationOptions) - Optional - Validation options.

### Returns
`PropertyDecorator`
